notes.title: Release Date & New Trailer
notes.notes: [p]Cheerleaders, it's time to assemble![/p][p][/p][p]We have a very good news for you: our colorful, joyful, and b*[b]d[/b]as* beat'em up Ra Ra BOOM will be released in a little bit more than a month! Save the date, you will be able to enjoy the full game on August 12. [/p][p][/p][p]Check the new trailer, hit the training ground, get to know your sheroes, and get ready for this brand new adventure! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="dKOXf0Ye5Ig;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In  the meantime, play the demo, ask us anything and follow us on social to not miss any announcement![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers ![/p]
